stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"With a high salary entered, the graphic says tax is due even after 6 years and shows a large income-tax figure, without making clear which money it is on.","where":"the graphic and its sentences","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: The '123 ממקור / מחושב / הזנתה / מונח' labels at the top are confusing and their purpose is unclear
'מה זה' piles on too many numbers and terms before showing what they mean for the reader
The 'הכי קרוב לזה: חשבון ניירות ערך' link doesn't say whether that option is better or worse
Codes like TXH-09, KH-15, PF-18 mean nothing to the reader
The 'תלוי בחברה' provider cards are confusing (depends on the company how?)
The tax paragraph repeats the 7.5%/15,712/20,566 numbers already given elsewhere
The 47% tax in the orange box is scary
The chief economist's recommendation to cut the benefit is worrying, since the benefit might disappear
In the 12-year bar chart, bars after year 6 still have a striped pink (tax) top even though that period is tax-free
Year-6 and year-12 results can't be seen without clicking; the default shows year 5, the bad year
Fee range text implies a higher fee gives more money, which seems backwards and lowers trust
Unclear how much tax is really paid: −64,761 vs 47% withheld vs refund
Unclear whether employer deposits above the ceiling get taxed from the paycheck at a 30,000 salary
Many jargon words are not understood (מסלול השקעה, מס רווחי הון, רווח ריאלי, etc.)
No figure for how much smaller the net monthly paycheck gets
No guidance on which company/plan to pick or how to tell the employer
Missing what happens to the fund on leaving the job
Missing a simple comparison against investing the 750 in the S&P 500 directly
Would cut the glossary table
Would cut the 'חוקים וכללים' chips and the top legend
Would cut the small-print notes under the chart

problems.why: The reader asks why the bars after year 6 still show a striped pink tax top even though that period is supposed to be tax-free, and that is a clear part of the person's complaint that the graphic shows tax due even after 6 years.
